summary: Tests the rule that sends a single very large project straight to the paged programme view.
purpose: Protects the routing rule from regressions.
why: Likely reason: a wrong threshold would load very large models in full and slow the app.
how: Checks that a single project at 100,001 activities routes directly, that exactly 100,000 does not, and that two projects together never route directly.
inputs: Made-up project records with activity counts.
outputs: Pass or fail for each case.
risks: Only checks the rule's numbers. It does not check that the paged view works.
debug: If it fails, check the limit constant and the check in programme.ts.
